BabyBlues.1:
I-baby blues kunye nempilo
yemiva emva kokubeletha
BabyBlues.2: Ukuqonda oko kunokutshintsha ngokwemiva emva kokubeletha nokwazi ixesha lokucela inkxaso.
BabyBlues.8: Emva kokubeletha, kuqhelekile ukudlula kwixesha apho imiva ivuka ngokukhulu. I-baby blues idla ngokuba yexeshana, kodwa ukudandatheka okuqhubekayo okanye okuya kukhula kufanele kujongwe yingcali.
BabyBlues.14: I-baby blues okanye ukudakumba emva kokubeletha?
BabyBlues.19: I-baby blues lixesha lotshintsho lwemiva olunokwenzeka kwiintsuku ezimbalwa zokuqala emva kokubeletha. Utshintsho lwehomoni, ukudinwa, ukungalali kakuhle, nokuzijongela kweli nqanaba elitsha zonke zinokubangela oku kuvuka kwemiva.
BabyBlues.20: Oku akuyonto yokuthotyelwa kwaye akuthethi ukuba ungumama ombi. Wonke umntu uzibona iintsuku zokuqala emva kokubeletha ngendlela yakhe.
BabyBlues.22: I-baby blues iqhelekile emva kokubeletha kwaye idla ngokuncipha yodwa kwiintsuku ezimbalwa.
BabyBlues.25: Oko abantu bakuvayo kuyahluka. Abanye bakuva ikakhulu ukudinwa nokuvuka kwemiva, ngoxa abanye banokuba notshintsho olubonakalayo kwimeko yengqondo.
BabyBlues.27: Ukulila lula okanye ukuvuka kwemiva ngakumbi.
BabyBlues.29: Imvakalelo inokuvakala inamandla ngakumbi kwaye itshintshe ngokukhawuleza.
BabyBlues.31: Imvakalelo yokuba buthathaka inokutshintshana namaxesha okuva ubuhle.
BabyBlues.33: Ukudinwa kwiintsuku zokuqala kunokwenza imivakalelo ibe nkulu.
BabyBlues.36: Kweli xesha, isidingo sokuphumla sikhulu. Izinto ezincinci nezilula zinokwenza iintsuku zibe lula.
BabyBlues.38: Ukusebenzisa naliphi na ixesha elikhululekileyo ukuze uphile.
BabyBlues.40: Musa ukunqena ukucela inkxaso kwabo bakungqongileyo.
BabyBlues.42: Ukuhlala unamanzi anele emzimbeni imini yonke.
BabyBlues.45: “Ukucela uncedo emva kokubeletha yindlela yokuzinyamekela wena nosana lwakho.”
BabyBlues.47: I-baby blues okanye ukudakumba emva kokubeletha?
BabyBlues.48: I-baby blues idla ngokuba yexeshana kwaye iyaphucuka kancinci kancinci. Ukudakumba emva kokubeletha kwahlukile: kunokuqhubeka ixesha elide, kube nzima ngakumbi, kwaye kube nempembelelo enkulu kubomi bemihla ngemihla.
BabyBlues.51: Idla ngokuba yexeshana, iphucuka kancinci kwiintsuku ezilandelayo.
BabyBlues.53: Kunokuhlala ixesha elide, kukhule, kwaye kufune inkxaso yengcali.
BabyBlues.56: Kubalulekile ukuthetha nengcali yezempilo ukuba ukudandatheka kwemiva akuphuculi, kuya kukhula, okanye kuqala ukwenza ubomi bemihla ngemihla bube nzima.
BabyBlues.61: Kuba nzima ukuzinyamekela okanye ukunyamekela usana lwakho.
BabyBlues.64: Umbelekisi, gqirha, ingcali yengqondo, okanye enye ingcali yezempilo inokukumamela, ihlole imeko, kwaye ikunike inkxaso efanelekileyo.
BabyBlues.66: Imivakalelo yemva kokubeletha ayisiyo mlinganiselo wokuba ungumama olungileyo kangakanani. Unelungelo lokufuna ukuphumla, lokumamelwa, nelokuxhaswa.
BabyBlues.70: Ukudinwa notshintsho lwehomoni kunokuchaphazela imeko yengqondo.
BabyBlues.71: Inkxaso evela kwabo bakungqongileyo inokwenza eli xesha libe lula.
BabyBlues.72: Ukudandatheka okuqhubekayo okanye okukhulu kufanele kuhlolwe yingcali.
BabyBlues.73: Eli nqaku lenzelwe ukwazisa kwaye aliyithatheli indawo iseluleko sezonyango esikulungeleyo wena. Ukuba uyathandabuza okanye unengxaki enkulu yokudandatheka, thetha nengcali yezempilo.
BabyBlues.74: Ukuzinyamekela nawe sisiqendu sexesha emva kokubeletha.
BabyBlues.75: I-baby blues kunye nempilo yemiva emva kokubeletha
BabyBlues.76:
I-baby blues kunye nempilo yemiva emva kokubeletha — AWA

Isikhokelo sokuqonda utshintsho lwemiva oluqhelekileyo emva kokubeletha.

BabyDevelopment.6: Indlela usana lwakho olukhula ngayo, itrimesta nganye.
BabyDevelopment.14: Ukususela ekuqaleni kweveki yesi-6, intliziyo encinci sele iqala ukubetha. Kule trimesta yokuqala, amalungu aphambili omzimba asenziwa kancinci kancinci.
BabyDevelopment.16: Ukubetha kwentliziyo yosana yenye yeempawu zokuqala ezibonakalayo kwi-ultrasound, rhoqo lixesha elinganyanzelekiyo ekunyanzelweni kwakho.
BabyDevelopment.17: Malunga neveki yama-20, usuku olungaphezulu ungavakalelwa ziintshukumo zokuqala zosana. Eli lixesha nalo apho iimvakalelo ziqala ukukhula.
BabyDevelopment.18: Ukususela kwitrimesta yesi-3, usana luyanda ngokukhawuleza kwaye lushukume kancinci lufike kwindawo yokuzalwa.
BabyDevelopment.19: Isantya sokukhula siyahluka phakathi kosana nosana: la manqaku aseyimilinganiselo eqhelekileyo.
BabyDevelopment.20: Ukususela kwiiveki ezi-6: intliziyo iqala ukubetha
BabyDevelopment.21: Malunga neeveki ezi-20: iintshukumo zokuqala ziyavakala
BabyDevelopment.23: Malunga neeveki ezingama-28: amehlo avuleka kancinci kancinci
BabyDevelopment.24: Usana “luva yonke into” ukususela ekuqaleni: ukuva akukhuli ngokwenene kude kube yitrimesta yesi-2
BabyDevelopment.25: Ubume besisu bubonisa isini sosana: akukho bungqina bezenzululwazi bunikela oku
BabyDevelopment.26: Usana olunamandla luphila ngcono ngokuqinisekileyo: amandla ahluka kakhulu phakathi kosana nosana
BabyDevelopment.28: Inqanaba ngalinye lokukhula kosana lilandela isantya salo; ukuhlolwa rhoqo ngugqirha kunceda ukuqinisekisa ukuba yonke into iqhubeka ngokuqhelekileyo.

BasalTemperature.6: Indlela elula yokuqinisekisa, emva kokuba kwenzekile, ukuba i-ovulation yenzekile.
BasalTemperature.15: Ubushushu bomzimba esiphumleni bubushushu bomzimba wakho xa uphumle ngokupheleleyo, ngaphambi kokwenza nasiphi na isenzo. Buyahluka kancinci kakhulu kwisithuba somjikelo, phantsi kwempembelelo yehomoni zakho.
BasalTemperature.16: Bulinganiswa rhoqo ekuseni, ngaphambi kokuba uvuke, ngexesha elinye rhoqo nangethemometha enye.
BasalTemperature.18: Sebenzisa rhoqo ithemometha enye, ngokufanelekileyo eyobushushu bomzimba esiphumleni (eyichanekileyo ngakumbi, kwishumi lenqanaba).
BasalTemperature.20: Linganisa ngexesha elimisiweyo, ngaphambi kokuvuka, emva kwemalunga neeyure ezi-3 zokulala ngaphandle kokuphazamiseka.
BasalTemperature.22: Bhala isiphumo kwangoko, ngaphambi kokuba uvuke okanye uthethe.
BasalTemperature.23: Ubushushu bomzimba esiphumleni buyanyuka kancinci (0.2 ukuya ku-0.5°C) emva nje kwe-ovulation, ngenxa ye-progesterone, kwaye buhlala bukhulu de kufike ixesha lakho elilandelayo.
BasalTemperature.25: Siphantsi kwinxalenye yokuqala yomjikelo, siyanyuka emva kwe-ovulation sihlale apho — umlinganiselo ocacayo emva kweentsuku ezininzi zokulinganisa.
BasalTemperature.31: Esi asiyiyo indlela yokuqikelela kodwa yindlela yokuqinisekisa: inceda uqonde ngcono umjikelo wakho, emva kokuba i-ovulation sele yenzekile — hayi ukuyilindela.
BasalTemperature.32: Ukuyijonga wedwa kumjikelo omnye okanye mibini ngokuqhelekileyo akwanelanga: umlinganiselo uvela ngokuphindaphinda.
BasalTemperature.34: Akukho kunyuka kobushushu okuvelayo kwimijikelo emininzi ephelele
BasalTemperature.35: Ubushushu buhlala bungaqhelekanga kakhulu nangona ulinganisa ngenyameko
BasalTemperature.36: Unemibuzo ngokuzala kwakho engenakuphendulwa kukulandela kwedwa
BasalTemperature.38: Ukudibanisa ubushushu bomzimba esiphumleni nokujonga i-cervical mucus yakho okanye iimvavanyo ze-ovulation kunika umfanekiso opheleleyo ngakumbi womjikelo wakho.
BasalTemperature.39: Ubushushu bomzimba esiphumleni buyanyuka kancinci (0.2 ukuya ku-0.5°C) kwangoko emva kwe-ovulation, ngenxa ye-progesterone.
BasalTemperature.40: Bulinganiswa rhoqo ekuseni, ngaphambi kokuvuka, ngexesha elinye rhoqo nangethemometha enye.
BasalTemperature.41: Esi asiyiyo indlela yokuqikelela kodwa yindlela yokuqinisekisa: inceda uqonde ngcono umjikelo wakho.
BasalTemperature.42: Ukuyidibanisa neminye imiqondiso (i-cervical mucus, iimvavanyo ze-ovulation) kunika umfanekiso opheleleyo ngakumbi.
BasalTemperature.43: Umxholo wolwazi. Eli nqaku aliyithatheli indawo iseluleko sezonyango esikulungeleyo wena. Ukuba uyathandabuza, buza ingcali yezempilo ukuba ikukhokele.

BirthControlPills.6: Indlela ipilisi esebenza ngayo, indlela yokuyisela imihla ngemihla, kunye nezibonelelo nemida yayo ephambili.
BirthControlPills.12: Ipilisi iqulethe iihomoni — i-estrogen kunye/okanye i-progestin, ngokwolwandle — ezisebenza ikakhulu ngokuthintela okanye ukuvala i-ovulation. Ikwatshintsha i-cervical mucus, nto leyo eyenza kube nzima ukuba isinyithi sidlule.
BirthControlPills.14: Zikho iintlobo ezininzi zepilisi, kuquka iipilisi ezidityanisiweyo neepilisi ze-progestin kuphela. Ukwakhiwa kwazo nendlela zisetyenziswa ngayo kunokwahluka.
BirthControlPills.15: Ukuyisela rhoqo kubalulekile. Ngokweentlobo zepilisi, okufanele ukwenze emva kokungatyi ipilisi kunokwahluka — ngoko kubalulekile ukujonga iphepha lolwazi lamayeza akho.
BirthControlPills.16: Khetha ixesha losuku elilula ukulikhumbula (isidlo, ixesha lokulala...)
BirthControlPills.17: Sebenzisa isikhumbuzo okanye i-app ukuba kuyadingeka
BirthControlPills.18: Gcina iphepha lolwazi liseduze ukuba uyathandabuza
BirthControlPills.19: Njengayo nayiphi na indlela yokuthintela ukukhulelwa, ipilisi ineenzuzo kodwa ikwanemida ethile ekufuneka uyazi ngaphambi kokuyikhetha.
BirthControlPills.22: Ithoba kakhulu umngcipheko wokukhulelwa xa isetyenziswa ngokuchanekileyo
BirthControlPills.23: Inokwenza ixesha lenyanga libe lilungelelaniswe kwaye liqikelelwe
BirthControlPills.33: Ipilisi yindlela esebenzayo yehomoni yokuthintela ukukhulelwa xa isetyenziswa ngokuchanekileyo. Ukuyisela rhoqo, iziphumo zayo ezinokubakho, kunye nokungakhuseli kwii-STI zizinto ezibalulekileyo ekufuneka ukwazi.
BirthControlPills.34: Ukuba ucinga ngokuthintela ukukhulelwa okanye indlela yakho yangoku ayikusebenzeli, musa ukunqena ukuthetha negqirha, umbelekisi, okanye enye ingcali yezempilo.

BoneHealth.6: Isizathu sokuba i-menopause inyuse umngcipheko we-osteoporosis, nendlela yokukhusela amathambo akho imihla ngemihla.
BoneHealth.8: Isizathu sokuba i-menopause ibenze amathambo abe buthathaka
BoneHealth.14: I-estrogen ngokwemvelo ikhusela ukuxinana kwamathambo ngokucothisa ukuvuselelwa kwawo. Ukuhla kwe-estrogen kwi-menopause kukhawulezisa ukulahleka kwamathambo, ngakumbi kwiminyaka embalwa yokuqala emva kokuba ixesha lenyanga liyeke.
BoneHealth.15: I-osteopenia ibhekisa kuxinano lwamathambo oluphantsi kunokuqhelekileyo, ngaphandle kokufikelela kumda we-osteoporosis. I-osteoporosis kukuba buthathaka kwamathambo okubonakalayo ngakumbi okunyusa umngcipheko wokophuka, ngakumbi xa kukho ukuwa.
BoneHealth.17: Amagama omabini achaza ukulahleka kokuxinana kwamathambo, hayi ukophuka sele kwenzekile — ayisiso isizathu sokuxhalaba kodwa yinto yokukhuthaza ukuthintela.
BoneHealth.18: Olu vavanyo alunabuhlungu lulinganisa ukuxinana kwamathambo. Lunokunikezelwa ngokweminyaka yakho, imbali yakho nembali yosapho, okanye ezinye izinto ezinyusa umngcipheko ezichongwe negqirha lakho.
BoneHealth.26: Umzimba ontsonkothileyo kakhulu okanye umthambo ophantsi kakhulu
BoneHealth.28: Ukuba nesinye okanye ezininzi zezi zinto akuthethi ukuba uya kuba ne-osteoporosis — zikhona ikakhulu ukunceda ukukhokela incoko negqirha lakho ngokuhlolwa okunokwenzeka.
BoneHealth.30: I-calcium, i-vitamin D, nomthambo wokuthwala ubunzima zihlala zizona zinto zemihla ngemihla eziluncedo kakhulu ekugcineni amandla amathambo ixesha elide.

Breastfeeding.7: Iintsuku zokuqala zokuncancisa lixesha lokufunda kusana nakumama. Ukubambelela, isantya, indawo yokuhlala, nokuqwalasela kunceda kancinci kancinci ukufumana oko kukulungeleyo.
Breastfeeding.16: Ukuncancisa kuvela kancinci kancinci. Iiyure zokuqala, emva koko iintsuku zokuqala, zinika usana nomama ixesha lokufunda kunye.
Breastfeeding.20: Ukudibana kolusu nolusu nokubambelela kwangoko kunokunceda ukuncancisa kuqale kakuhle.
Breastfeeding.22: Usana lunokunqwenela ukunxila rhoqo. Kuqhelekile ukuba isantya sitshintshe.
Breastfeeding.24: Ukuncancisa kuba sisantya esabelwana kusana nomama kancinci kancinci.
Breastfeeding.26: Ubisi luvela kancinci kancinci ngokweemfuno zosana.
Breastfeeding.28: Kunokuba ujonge ixesha kuphela, kunokunceda ukujonga iimpawu zokuvuka kosana, ukuncancisa, nokutshintsha kweendiaper.
Breastfeeding.30: Usana olusandula ukuzalwa lunokucela ukuncanciswa rhoqo, ngamanye amaxesha amaxesha angama-8 ukuya kwayi-12 kwiiyure ezingama-24.
Breastfeeding.32: Usana lunokushukuma, luvule umlomo, okanye lufune ibele xa luqala ukulamba.
Breastfeeding.34: Inani leediaper ezimanzi nezimdaka lelinye lezinto zokujonga imihla ngemihla.
Breastfeeding.36: Indawo yokuhlala enenkululeko nokubambelela okusebenzayo kunokwenza ukuncancisa kube lula. Ukuba iintlungu zinkulu okanye ziyaqhubeka, ingcali yezempilo inokujonga indawo yokuhlala nokubambelela.
Breastfeeding.42: Usana luncanyelwe emzimbeni, nentloko yalo isendaweni enenkululeko.
Breastfeeding.44: Linda umlomo uvuleke ngokwaneleyo ngaphambi kokuba unike ibele.
Breastfeeding.46: Ukubambelela okusebenzayo akufanele kubangele intlungu enkulu okanye eqhubekayo.
Breastfeeding.48: Iintshukumo zokunxila nokugwiliza zinokubonwa ngexesha lokuncancisa.
Breastfeeding.50: Akukho mfuneko yokulinda de iingxaki zibe nzima. Ingcali eqeqeshiweyo inokunceda ukujonga indawo yokuhlala, ukubambelela, okanye iimfuno zosana.
Breastfeeding.58: Iintsuku zokuqala zinokwahluka kakhulu. Isantya sokuncancisa nenani lobisi zinokutshintsha kancinci ngokuhamba kwexesha. Ukuba kukho into ekuxhalabisayo, buza ingcali yezempilo ukuba ikucebise.
Breastfeeding.60: Ukuncancisa kokuqala lixesha lokufunda kusana nakumama.
Breastfeeding.61: Usana olusandula ukuzalwa lunokucela ukuncanciswa rhoqo.
Breastfeeding.62: Indawo yokuhlala enenkululeko nokubambelela kakuhle kubalulekile.
Breastfeeding.63: Ukujonga iimpawu zosana kunceda ngakumbi kunokujonga ishedyuli emiselwe kakuhle.
Breastfeeding.64: Umbelekisi okanye ingcali yokuncancisa inokukunceda kwiingxaki zokuqala.
Breastfeeding.65: Umxholo wolwazi. Eli nqaku aliyithatheli indawo isikhokelo sengcali yezempilo esikulungeleyo wena.

CervicalMucus.6: Umqondiso wemvelo, ongabizi, wokubona ixesha lakho lokukwazi ukukhulelwa.
CervicalMucus.15: Yinto eveliswa ngokwemvelo yintsimbi yomlomo webele. I-cervical mucus itshintsha ubume kwisithuba somjikelo phantsi kwempembelelo ye-estrogen ne-progesterone.
CervicalMucus.17: I-mucus encinci, rhoqo kukho imvakalelo yokoma.
CervicalMucus.21: Icacile, iyatsalwa, kwaye iyabamba, ifana nokumhlophe weqanda eliluhlaza.
CervicalMucus.30: Jonga ukubonakala nobume usebenzisa iphepha lokuhlambela okanye iminwe ehlambulukileyo, ngexesha elifana losuku, uze ubhale oko ukuqaphelayo.
CervicalMucus.33: Ukuthintela ukukhulelwa ngehomoni okanye unyango oluthile
CervicalMucus.35: Wonke umntu unobume obahlukileyo, kwaye ukuqonda owakho kufuna ukuziqhelanisa kwimijikelo emininzi. Ukujonga olu tshintsho yonke imihla, kunye neminye imiqondiso, kunceda ukuchonga ngcono ixesha lakho lokukwazi ukukhulelwa — kodwa ayithathi ndawo yeseluleko sezonyango ukuba uxhalabile.
CervicalMucus.37: Ukudibanisa i-cervical mucus nobushushu bomzimba wakho esiphumleni okanye iimvavanyo ze-ovulation kunika umfanekiso opheleleyo ngakumbi womjikelo wakho.
CervicalMucus.38: I-cervical mucus itshintsha ubume kwisithuba somjikelo phantsi kwempembelelo ye-estrogen ne-progesterone.
CervicalMucus.39: Xa i-ovulation isondela, iba nocaca, iyatsalwa, kwaye iyabamba, ifana nokumhlophe weqanda eliluhlaza.
CervicalMucus.40: Ukujonga olu tshintsho yonke imihla, kunye neminye imiqondiso, kunceda ukuchonga ngcono ixesha lakho lokukwazi ukukhulelwa.
CervicalMucus.41: Ukuqonda umlinganiselo wakho kufuna ukuziqhelanisa nemijikelo emininzi yokujonga.
CervicalMucus.42: Umxholo wolwazi. Eli nqaku aliyithatheli indawo iseluleko sezonyango esikulungeleyo wena. Ukuba uyathandabuza, buza ingcali yezempilo ukuba ikukhokele.

ChildbirthPrep.6: Izinsika ezintathu zokujongana nosuku olukhulu ngokuzithemba ngakumbi.
ChildbirthPrep.16: Iiklasi zokulungiselela ukubeletha zinceda ukuqonda amanqanaba okubeletha nezindlela zokuphefumla ezizakukuxhasa ngosuku olukhulu.
ChildbirthPrep.17: Ukupakisha ingxowa yakho yasesibhedlela ngenyanga yesi-8 kukusindisa uxinzelelo lwemizuzu yokugqibela. Idla ngokubandakanya:
ChildbirthPrep.23: Abo ungathanda ukuba babekhona ngexesha lokubeletha
ChildbirthPrep.24: Iinkolelo zakho malunga nokudibana kolusu nolusu
ChildbirthPrep.25: Isicwangciso esilula sokubeletha sinceda ukwabelana ngezinto ozifunayo neqela lezonyango, ngoxa uhlala ungavalekanga: ukuhamba kwezinto ngokwenene kunokutshintsha ngokwemeko.
ChildbirthPrep.27: Ukulungiselela akuthethi ukulawula yonke into: kukukunika izixhobo zokujongana nosuku olukhulu ngokuzithemba ngakumbi nokungaqinisekanga kancinci.

ChooseHormonalMethod.6: Imibuzo efanelekileyo yokuzibuza ukuze ufumane indlela yokuthintela ukukhulelwa ehambelana nobomi bakho bemihla ngemihla, iimfuno zakho, nezicwangciso zakho.
ChooseHormonalMethod.13: Akukho ndlela iyodwa efanelekileyo yokuthintela ukukhulelwa kwabo bonke abantu. Ngaphambi kokukhetha indlela, kunokunceda ukucinga ngemikhwa yakho, oko ukuthandayo, indlela umzimba wakho ongabuthatha ngayo, nezicwangciso zakho.
ChooseHormonalMethod.15: Ndifuna isenzo semihla ngemihla okanye seveki, okanye isisombululo esihlala ixesha elide?
ChooseHormonalMethod.16: Ndinawo na isicwangciso sokukhulelwa kwixesha elilandelayo?
ChooseHormonalMethod.17: Yintoni ibhajethi yam, kwaye le ndlela yokuthintela ukukhulelwa ifumaneka lula kangakanani?
ChooseHormonalMethod.18: Abantuababini banokukhetha iindlela ezahlukeneyo kwaye bobabini benze ukhetho olufanelekileyo kwimeko yabo. Ukhetho olufanelekileyo luxhomekeke ikakhulu kwindlela ofuna ukusebenzisa ngayo ukuthintela ukukhulelwa nakoko ukufunayo.
ChooseHormonalMethod.20: Indlela ebonakala ikhangeleka ephepheni ayisiyo yonke into eya kuba lula okanye enenkululeko kakhulu kuwe imihla ngemihla.
ChooseHormonalMethod.21: Ukuthelekisa ezinye iindlela, ungajonga izinto ezahlukeneyo. Injongo ayikukwazi yonke into ngentloko, kodwa kukuchonga oko kubalulekileyo kuwe ngokwenene.
ChooseHormonalMethod.23: Ezinye iindlela zifuna isenzo semihla ngemihla, ngoxa ezinye zifuna ukuqwalasela kweveki kuphela, okanye ngaphantsi kakhulu.
ChooseHormonalMethod.25: Iziphumo ozivayo zinokwahluka phakathi komntu nomntu. Kubalulekile ukuqaphela indlela umzimba wakho osabela ngayo kwaye uthethe ukuba kukho into ekuphazamisayo.
ChooseHormonalMethod.27: Ukuba unethemba lokukhulelwa kungekudala, ixesha lokusebenzisa nokubuya kokuzala emva kokuyeka kunokuba yinxalenye yoko ukuthetha ngako.
ChooseHormonalMethod.29: Ukusebenza akuxhomekeki kuphela kwindlela ekhethiweyo, kodwa nakwindlela oyisebenzisa ngokuchanekileyo nangokuqhubekayo.
ChooseHormonalMethod.31: Umahluko obalulekileyo phakathi kweendlela kukuba rhoqo kangakanani ekufuneka ucinge ngokuthintela kwakho ukukhulelwa.
ChooseHormonalMethod.42: Ukujonga indlela umzimba wakho osabela ngayo
ChooseHormonalMethod.43: Indlela yehomoni inokuvakala ngokwahlukileyo komntu ngomntu. Abanye baqaphela utshintsho kumjikelo wabo, ekophiweni, okanye kwezinye iziphumo ezingathandekiyo. Olu sabelo aluthethi ngokuzenzekelayo ukuba indlela ayikufanelanga, kodwa kufaneleka ukuluqwalasela.
ChooseHormonalMethod.45: Ukuba isiphumo sikhulu, siyaqhubeka, okanye asiqhelekanga, musa ukuhlala wedwa nemibuzo yakho. Igqirha, umbelekisi, okanye enye ingcali yezempilo inokukunceda unqumle ukuqhubeka, ukulungisa, okanye ukutshintsha indlela.
ChooseHormonalMethod.47: Izicwangciso zakho zokukhulelwa zinokuchaphazela ukhetho lwakho. Ukuba ufuna ukuphepha ukukhulelwa iminyaka emininzi, indlela ehlala ixesha elide inokufaneleka ukuqwalaselwa. Ukuba ucinga ngokukhulelwa kwangoko, ezinye iindlela zinokuhambelana ngcono nexesha lakho.
ChooseHormonalMethod.49: Ukuthetha ngezicwangciso zakho zokukhulelwa, nokuba zisekude okanye azingqinisekanga, kunceda ingcali yezempilo ukukhokela incoko ngcono.
ChooseHormonalMethod.50: Idinga likuvumela ukuthelekisa izibonelelo, imiqobo, nezinto ezinokuthintela ukusetyenziswa kwendlela nganye. Ungazilungiselela imibuzo embalwa kwangaphambili ukuze ungalibali nto ibalulekileyo.
ChooseHormonalMethod.55: Kufuneka ndenze ntoni ukuba ndiyalibala, ukuba ishukuma ngaphandle kwendawo, okanye ukuba ndifuna ukuyiyeka?
ChooseHormonalMethod.56: Ingaba le ndlela ihambelana nezicwangciso zam zokukhulelwa?
ChooseHormonalMethod.58: Umbelekisi okanye igqirha lingaqwalasela imbali yakho yezonyango, unyango, oko ukuthandayo, nendlela yakho yokuphila ngaphambi kokucebisa indlela.
ChooseHormonalMethod.60: Khetha indlela ehambelana nobomi bakho bemihla ngemihla.
ChooseHormonalMethod.61: Qwalasela indlela umzimba wakho onyamezela ngayo noko ukuthandayo.
ChooseHormonalMethod.62: Cinga ngezicwangciso zakho zokukhulelwa nexesha lakho.
ChooseHormonalMethod.65: Indlela engcono ayisiyo ngokuqinisekileyo leyo ibonakala ilula okanye idumileyo kakhulu. Yeyo ehambelana nemeko yakho, iimfuno zakho, noko ukuthandayo, emva kwengxoxo enolwazi nengcali yezempilo.
ChooseHormonalMethod.66: Eli nqaku lenzelwe ukwazisa kuphela kwaye aliyithatheli indawo iseluleko sezonyango esikulungeleyo wena.

ConceptionLifestyle.6: Imikhwa elula enokuxhasa uhambo lwakho — ngaphandle koxinzelelo.
ConceptionLifestyle.12: Eminye imikhwa elula yokuphila inokuxhasa uhambo lokukhulelwa, nangona ingenakuqinisekisa isiphumo yodwa.
ConceptionLifestyle.17: Uxinzelelo olungapheliyo lunokuchaphazela ukulingana kwehomoni kwaye, kwabanye abafazi, nokulungelelana komjikelo. Ukuzinika amaxesha okuzola yinxalenye epheleleyo yohambo.
ConceptionLifestyle.19: Ukufuna “ukwenza yonke into ngokuchanekileyo” kunokuba yimbangela yoxinzelelo: ukujolisa kwimikhwa elungileyo ngokubanzi kwanele, ngaphandle kokufuna ukugqibelela.
ConceptionLifestyle.20: Ukutshaya, okunokuchaphazela ukuzala kubo bobabini abalingane
ConceptionLifestyle.22: Uqeqesho lwemidlalo olunamandla, olude, olunokucothisa ukuzala ngokuchaseneyo
ConceptionLifestyle.23: Iswekile eyingaphezulu eyenziweyo, enokuphazamisa ukulingana kwehomoni
ConceptionLifestyle.25: Imikhwa elungileyo ngokubanzi, ngaphandle kwemfumba okanye ukufuna ukugqibelela, yeyona nkxaso engcono yemihla ngemihla.

ConceptionStart.6: Izikhokelo eziphambili zokuqala uhambo lwakho lokukhulelwa ngokuzithemba.
ConceptionStart.12: Inyathelo lokuqala eliluncedo kakhulu kukuchonga ixesha lakho lokukwazi ukukhulelwa usebenzisa umjikelo wakho: ubude bomjikelo, iimpawu zomzimba, kwaye, ukuba uyafuna, izixhobo zokulandela ezifana neemvavanyo ze-ovulation okanye ubushushu bomzimba esiphumleni.
ConceptionStart.13: Ukwabelana ngesondo rhoqo, rhoqo emva kweentsuku ezi-2 ukuya kwezi-3, ngokwemvelo kugubungela ixesha lakho lokuzala kakhulu ngaphandle kokufuna icwangciso eliqinileyo kakhulu.
ConceptionStart.14: Akukho mfuneko yokuzithintela kusuku lwe-ovulation kuphela
ConceptionStart.15: Isantya esiqhelekileyo silula ukusigcina kunecwangciso eliqinileyo
ConceptionStart.16: Impilo yezibini ibalulekile nayo ngeli xesha
ConceptionStart.17: Uninzi lwezibini lukhulelwa kwiinyanga ezili-12 emva kokuyeka ukuthintela ukukhulelwa. Eli xesha liyahluka ngokwezinto ezininzi ezibhekisele kwimeko nganye.
ConceptionStart.19: Ngaphaya kweenyanga ezili-12 (okanye iinyanga ezi-6 emva kweminyaka engama-35), kucetyiswa ukuba ubone ingcali yezempilo ukuze ihlolwe, nangona oku kungathethi ukuba kukho ingxaki.
ConceptionStart.21: Ukwazi umjikelo wakho, ukugcina isantya sendalo, nokunyamezela zizinsika ezintathu zokuqala ngokuzola olu hambo.
